description: Western Digital Corporation, founded in 1970 and a Standard & Poor's 500 company headquartered in San Jose, California, is a leading developer, manufacturer and provider of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive technology, and HDDs are critical components in the global data infrastructure market that play an essential role in enabling the AI-driven data economy, providing reliable, cost-effective, high-capacity storage for a broad range of applications including cloud data centers, enterprise storage systems, edge computing, smart video, and client and consumer devices. Its broad portfolio of technology and products, sold under the Western Digital and WD brands, addresses customers' storage needs through multiple end markets: Cloud, its largest and fastest growing end market comprised primarily of products for public or private cloud environments and enterprise customers; Client, providing OEM and channel customers a broad array of high-performance HDD solutions across desktop and notebooks; and Consumer, offering a comprehensive portfolio of HDD external storage products offered globally through retail and channel partners. Its fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest to June 30 and typically consists of 52 weeks.
